name: XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES
description: XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES contains the general information, which identifies a party with the classification of legal entity.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the legal entity.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier for the legal entity.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique number used to identify a legal entity; either manually set by the user or composed of the country of registration and the registration number of the identifying jurisdiction if automatically generated. This is only relevant for third party legal entity.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the legal entity that belongs to your own corporate structure (enterprise).

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Region or district assigned to a representative, agent, or the like, as for making sales.

columns.name: TRANSACTING_ENTITY_FLAG
columns.description: Whether or not the legal entity is allowed to generate business transactions. Not currently used.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective start date of the legal entity.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective end date of the legal entity.
